recommended_fix: Replace 120mm 24V DC ball bearing exhaust fan, clean heatsink, reset bypass alarm
technician_notes: Replaced cooling fans. UPS transferred back to online inverter mode.

complaint: UPS switching automatically to Static Bypass mode with Overload error.
symptoms: Bypass LED active, inverter offline, cooling fans operating at maximum RPM
diagnosis: Inverter DC-AC bridge heat-sink thermal sensor triggering due to fan failure
root_cause: Exhaust fan 1 seized up with dust ball causing IGBT heatsink to reach 85°C
recommended_fix: Replace 120mm 24V DC ball bearing exhaust fan, clean heatsink, reset bypass alarm
technician_notes: Replaced cooling fans. UPS transferred back to online inverter mode.

complaint: Water purifier flow rate has dropped to a trickle, taking 10 mins to fill one bottle.
symptoms: Very slow permeate flow, high reject water flow ratio, booster pump running continuously
diagnosis: Sediment pre-filter and activated carbon block choked with silt
root_cause: High turbidity in incoming municipal water supply over past 2 weeks
recommended_fix: Replace 5-micron spun polypropylene pre-filter and 10-inch CTO carbon block
technician_notes: Pre-filters replaced. Flow rate restored to 50 LPH at 60 PSI.

complaint: Water leaking continuously from flush tank and floor flooded near washroom.
symptoms: Continuous water running into toilet bowl, float valve not shutting off, water pool on floor
diagnosis: Defective flush tank siphon flapper valve and degraded float ball seal
root_cause: Mineral scaling and rubber flapper hardening preventing watertight seal at flush valve seat
recommended_fix: Replace dual-flush siphon valve assembly, adjust float arm water level, test seal
technician_notes: Replaced flapper valve and adjusted float level. Water leakage fully arrested.

complaint: Urinal auto-flusher sensor not triggering and water pooling in drain trap.
symptoms: No flush on user exit, solenoid valve clicking faintly, foul odor in restroom
diagnosis: Infrared sensor optical window calcification and 6V solenoid valve diaphragm jam
root_cause: Hard water mineral scale clogging solenoid pilot orifice and smudged sensor window
recommended_fix: Clean IR sensor lens, descale solenoid valve diaphragm with dilute acid, replace lithium battery
technician_notes: Descaled solenoid pilot channel. Tested auto-flush with 10 simulated passes.

complaint: Washbasin drain pipe blocked and water backing up during peak usage.
symptoms: Slow sink drainage, standing soapy water in basin, gurgling sound in waste pipe
diagnosis: Hair and soap residue blockage in bottle trap and PVC P-trap bend
root_cause: Accumulated grease and foreign fibers in 32mm drain waste pipe
recommended_fix: Dismantle and clear P-trap, snake drain pipe with mechanical auger, reseal slip joints
technician_notes: Bottle trap cleared and cleaned. 10-liter flow test drained cleanly without obstruction.

complaint: Heavy water dripping from under-sink CP angle cock valve and flexible connector.
symptoms: Water spraying under washbasin, floor soaked, water meter spinning
diagnosis: Braided stainless steel connection hose inner EPDM rubber burst due to high pressure
root_cause: Pressure spike in overhead water line and age fatigue on flexible hose
recommended_fix: Replace 1/2-inch stainless steel braided flexible connector hose and Teflon tape thread seal
technician_notes: Replaced braided hose and installed pressure-rated angle valve.

complaint: Toilet flush handle broken and stuck down causing constant water wastage.
symptoms: Loose flush handle lever, chain disconnected inside cistern, water continuously draining
diagnosis: Broken nylon actuator lever arm connecting handle to siphon discharge valve
root_cause: Excessive downward force applied to plastic cistern handle lever arm
recommended_fix: Install heavy-duty brass cistern flush lever arm and stainless steel connecting chain
technician_notes: Installed brass lever arm and adjusted linkage chain length.

complaint: Water bath heating mantle failing to maintain temperature with test tubes boiling dry.
symptoms: Temperature overshoot exceeding 80°C setpoint, erratic digital PID readout, burnt chemical odor
diagnosis: Pt100 RTD temperature sensor probe open-circuit and stuck solid-state relay (SSR)
root_cause: Corrosive acid vapor penetrating sensor sheath causing thermocouple lead corrosion
recommended_fix: Replace chemical-resistant Pt100 RTD sensor probe, replace 25A solid-state relay, recalibrate PID
technician_notes: New Teflon-sheathed Pt100 sensor installed. Water bath temperature calibrated within ±0.2°C.

complaint: Fume hood exhaust airflow alarm beeping with low face velocity warning.
symptoms: Exhaust fan velocity below 0.5 m/s, air baffle fluttering, chemical fume buildup in lab
diagnosis: Exhaust blower V-belt slippage and particulate accumulation on pre-filter screen
root_cause: Chemical vapor residue and dust coating exhaust intake mesh filter
recommended_fix: High-pressure clean intake baffles, adjust blower belt tension, recalibrate thermal anemometer sensor
technician_notes: Baffles cleaned
status: belt tension adjusted. Face velocity measured at 0.58 m/s (safe compliant range).

complaint: Test tube shaker and vortex mixer motor vibrating violently and smelling of burning coil.
symptoms: Motor stalling under load, loud grinding from eccentric bearing, rubber cup wobbling
diagnosis: Worn eccentric drive bearing and carbon brush degradation on universal motor
root_cause: High rotational load and chemical solvent splash onto motor housing
recommended_fix: Replace drive eccentric bearing assembly, replace carbon brushes, lubricate drive shaft
technician_notes: Bearing replaced. Vortex mixing speed tested smooth across 0-3000 RPM range.

complaint: Glassware autoclave pressure vessel gasket leaking steam and failing to reach sterilization pressure.
symptoms: Steam hissing from door rim, pressure gauge hovering at 10 PSI instead of 15 PSI, cycle aborted
diagnosis: Hardened silicone lid gasket and dirty micro-switch safety interlock
root_cause: Heat cycling fatigue and mineral salt crusting along chamber sealing flange
recommended_fix: Descale lid sealing channel, install new food-grade high-temp silicone gasket, test pop-off valve
technician_notes: New gasket fitted. Autoclave reached 121°C at 15 PSI hold for full 20-min cycle successfully.

complaint: High-speed refrigerated centrifuge displaying 'E-03 Rotor Imbalance' error and refusing to spin.
symptoms: Rotor lid lock stuck, imbalance optical sensor triggered, motor vibrating on acceleration
diagnosis: Optical speed encoder disc contaminated with dust and worn motor suspension dampeners
root_cause: Motor rubber shock mounts degraded from solvent vapors causing excessive precession swing
recommended_fix: Clean optical encoder sensor, replace 4-point vibration isolator rubber bushes, re-level chamber
technician_notes: Vibration isolators replaced. Centrifuge tested balanced up to 14

complaint: Spectrophotometer absorbance values drifting wildly during test tube optical measurements.
symptoms: Unstable photometric baseline, tungsten-halogen lamp dimming intermittently, calibration fail
diagnosis: Degraded 6V 20W tungsten halogen lamp bulb filament and tarnished reference mirror
root_cause: Lamp operating hours exceeded 2000 hours rating causing filament evaporation
recommended_fix: Replace tungsten-halogen source lamp, clean optical mirrors with optical lens paper, run zero-point calibration
technician_notes: New calibrated halogen source installed. Baseline stability verified <0.002 Abs/hour.

complaint: LED panel lights flickering intermittently and causing visual strain during lectures.
symptoms: Strobe flickering at 50Hz, humming sound from driver enclosure in false ceiling
diagnosis: Failed electrolytic capacitor in constant-current LED driver module
root_cause: Thermal stress inside sealed false ceiling cavity drying out driver filter capacitors
recommended_fix: Replace 40W constant-current isolated LED driver unit, verify neutral line continuity
technician_notes: Replaced LED driver with surge-protected 40W unit. Flicker percentage <1% verified.

complaint: Corridor switchboard socket sparking and hot to touch when lab equipment plugged in.
symptoms: Audible crackling sound, scorch marks on socket faceplate, circuit trip risk
diagnosis: Loose terminal screw connection and oxidized brass contact prongs inside 16A socket
root_cause: Repeated high-draw appliance usage causing thermal loosening of copper wire terminals
recommended_fix: Isolate circuit, replace 16A modular power socket and faceplate, retighten terminal connections
technician_notes: Installed heavy-duty 16A socket with ceramic base and flame-retardant faceplate.
